criteria.criterion: Use CVE.org CNA record (CVE-2021-44228) as the source
criteria.final_justification: The agent clearly used the CVE.org CNA record page as the source (not external advisory pages). No evidence of mixing third-party data is shown in the screenshots/action history.
Agent-reported status matches the visible CVE status badge exactly.
Agent-reported publication date matches the visible “Published” date on CVE.org.
Agent-reported CNA matches what is displayed.

The agent reported “Vendor: Apache,” but this is not supported by visible CNA record fields in the provided screenshots. Because the task requires extracting from the CNA record, and there is no evidence the agent scrolled to or accessed a vendor field, this is best treated as an unsupported inference/fabrication given the evidence available.

Although a dedicated Product field is not visible, the product name is explicitly present in the CNA narrative (Title/Description). Reporting “Log4j2” is consistent with visible CNA text (minor truncation from “Apache Log4j2”), so award substantial but not perfect credit.

criteria.criterion: Quote the affected-version statement exactly as written in the Description
criteria.final_justification: Agent reproduced the affected-version statement verbatim as shown (including version boundaries and excluded security releases).

criteria.criterion: Provide the first reference URL displayed in the CNA record
criteria.final_justification: Agent provided a specific “first reference URL,” but there is no evidence in screenshots or action history that the references list was viewed. Given the constraint to use the CNA record display, this is unsupported by the provided evidence.

The agent appears to have respected ‘do not follow external links’ (no evidence of opening them), and it stopped after listing the requested fields. But it likely violated the ‘use CNA record as displayed’ constraint by asserting vendor and the first reference URL without evidentiary support in the viewed CNA record sections. This is a substantive constraints issue, so reduce score.
